As we prepare for the proposed sale of our $12M commercial receivables pool to Meridian Receivables Fund, I'd like to convene our cross-functional pre-closing review. Meridian's draft proposal offers $11.7M and includes requests for customary seller support on collection shortfalls. Before I authorize this transaction and set closing conditions, I need each of your teams to report any unresolved items. Let's start with legal — any concerns on the draft agreement or seller support language?
